summary.name: Videobolt
summary.one_liner: Videobolt is a browser-based online video maker that lets users build branded videos from a library of professionally designed templates.
use_cases: Making slideshow videos without editing skills
summary.what_it_does: Videobolt is a browser-based video maker offering a library of 21,200+ video templates designed by visual effects professionals. Users can personalize templates by swapping in their own media, text, music, colors and effects. The templates cover styles from glitchy 3D intros to minimal slideshows. The page positions it for creators, businesses and agencies who need quick video output without learning professional editing software.
notable: Customize media, text, music, colors and effects
Browser-based with no editing skills required
caveats: Pricing details are not stated on the page
Page text is mostly marketing; specific features and limits are not described
